title: PageFlipper
description: Full-stack Library Management App with Angular, Spring Boot & MySQL. Explore books, manage orders, and interact with community-driven posts.

title: PokeCenter
description: Modern, responsive Pokédex with dynamic search, type filtering, and detailed Pokémon profiles using Angular & Firebase.

title: SmartCart
description: Full-featured online store inspired by Amazon, with user accounts, cart, search, and virtual currency.
